shared: Your own units dying, in the fight or on purpose while recruiting, is how Fruit units grow.
differ: What a death turns into: a pile shared out overnight, a bigger unit in its slot, or spendable change.

takes.label: The overnight harvest
takes.line: Each death pours its printed stats into one Compost pile, and every Fruit unit eats a quarter of it each turn, for good.
takes.look_if: a board that visibly gets bigger every turn from what died.

takes.label: Sell it, it sprouts
takes.line: Selling counts as dying: a sold or killed Fruit unit leaves a Sprout in its slot, each one bigger, and Candlesnuff Abbess chains refills mid-fight.
takes.look_if: the shop as a funeral and fights where empty slots refill.

takes.label: Making exact change
takes.line: Compost is saved coins, one per death; Fruits pay set prices in board order, so where Puffwell sits decides who's fed.
takes.look_if: a seating-and-spending puzzle each turn, with small, sure gains.
